verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is an AML/KYC compliance and onboarding screening platform, so onboarding-funnel analytics is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence, however, shows no dashboards or reports for verification pass rates, drop-off points, or completion time by country or document type. Raw data exports (customer screening and case exports) are building blocks a user could analyse externally, which earns no credit toward the analytics capability itself.
